approval_rule: A missing baseline file must have its own exact before-hash approval. Every modified baseline path remains in the governed count and path digest. Authored and source content remains raw-hashed. Two exact self-updating generated reports contribute code-owned policy tokens instead of circular live hashes and remain separately schema-gated, packaged, clean-room reproduced, restored and receipt-bound. New files are outside this historical baseline and remain governed by current release gates and package manifests.
